name: How can I tell if the hot spot on my floor is a plumbing leak or something else?

mainEntity.name: How can I tell if the hot spot on my floor is a plumbing leak or something else?

acceptedAnswer.text: The most definitive way to distinguish a plumbing leak from other issues is to contact a professional plumber. However, some indicators might help you speculate: A constant hot spot, especially if accompanied by a higher-than-usual water bill or the sound of running water when all fixtures are off, strongly suggests a leak. If you have radiant floor heating, check if that system is operating. For certainty and to prevent further damage, professional leak detection is essential.
acceptedAnswer.description: A professional plumber can definitively diagnose a hot spot. Look for constant warmth, higher water bills, or running water sounds as leak indicators.
